questions.text: Describe a live performance you watched.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a live performance you watched. You should say: what the performance was; where and when you watched it; who you watched it with; and explain why you enjoyed it, or why you did not.

questions.text: Would you like to see the same performers again?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you like to see the same performers again?

questions.text: Why do people still go to concerts and plays when they can watch them online?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a live performance you watched, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all live performances. Why do people still go to concerts and plays when they can watch them online?
